earlierAttempts.issue: Options expected a desktop widget to win the screen hit test above a foreground Explorer window after clearing topmost.
earlierAttempts.resolution: Check WS_EX_TOPMOST removal, native desktop parent restoration, live/visible windows and persistence. Corrected options run passes 79 assertions.

earlierAttempts.issue: Clock capture setup changed tabs before saving topmost; neutral backdrop obscured widgets despite passing UI assertions.
earlierAttempts.resolution: Save capture settings before switching tabs; require rendered content pixels. Final 16 captures visually reviewed, 114 assertions pass. Initial images excluded.

earlierAttempts.resolution: Temporarily raise only the settings window, check 49 client hit-test points, capture client area. Rerun ui-review/design; replace public images with 467/573 assertion runs.
